decisions.reason: The quoted sentence states that TRPML1 activation reduced lysosomal storage of Gb3 and SubC in CLN3-KO cells. While the quote does not explicitly state a therapeutic effect on CLN3 disease as a whole, the surrounding abstract clearly establishes that these CLN3-KO cells represent a disease model (ARPE-19 CLN3-KO cells model CLN3 disease), and the observed reduction of disease-associated storage phenotypes supports a therapeutic effect. However, confidence is medium because the effect is partial (it failed to restore BMP levels) and the abstract frames this as a cell model study rather than clinical evidence.

The quoted sentence directly states 'we identified TRPML1-mediated enhanced lysosomal exocytosis as a likely mechanism for clearing storage'. This explicitly establishes TRPML1 as mediating/affecting the mechanism of lysosomal exocytosis. The abstract clearly treats lysosomal exocytosis as a mechanism (described as the mechanism for clearing storage), not merely as a pathway.
